Slop Ledger · In development

Accounting ledger

Double-entry books, trial balance and exchange rates.

Open now

Slop Ledger has these main features: Chart of accounts, journal and reversals; General ledger and trial balance.

In development: some features listed below may not be finished yet.

What you can do with Slop Ledger

  • Make a profit and loss statement
  • Make a balance sheet
  • Reconcile your bank statement
  • A free QuickBooks alternative, in your browser
  • Import an SIE file into your books
  • Import a bank statement and match it to your books
